issues.reason: The specificational copula is uncovered (the reviewer's own q2 gap) and the vocabulary has no identity head, so reversing it into a predication of each named individual keeps every atom true and asserts less, not more; the only content the reversal loses is exhaustivity, which the instruction set explicitly declines to encode ("Do NOT emit an exclusion rule ... full exhaustivity inference is closure-gated").

Patient names the change-of-state undergoer, but what declines is the population (already carried inside the compound population_decline), and the text attaches the decline to the county only by "with" — the licensed record is the entity-attached surface preposition, exactly as "wool from Calderwick" takes (From sk_wool_1 calderwick) rather than a wrong-fact relation.
Same mis-slot for Posey: (Patient sk_decline_2 posey) asserts the county underwent the declining rather than recording the attributive "with".
Same mis-slot for Madison: (Patient sk_decline_3 madison) asserts the county underwent the declining rather than recording the attributive "with".

Under the reversal the clause's "will be" has only the decline to attach to — wrapping the copular atom instead would give (Future (Member vermillion county)), falsely claiming Vermillion is not yet a county — so (Future sk_decline_N) is the faithful placement of the tense the text does state.

gaps_confirmed: specificational / identificational copular clause "the Ns will be A, B and C", where the predicate is a list of named individuals identifying the subject set — Categorical statements covers only predicational "X is a N" / "X is ADJ", and there is no identity head

an attributive "with"-PP modifying a common noun ("counties with population declines") — the with-phrase rules are event-side (CoAgent vs Instrument) and the entity-attached preposition licence is framed for position and origin, so nothing states that it extends to an attributed eventuality
new_gaps: a bare-plural subject restricted by a PP ("counties with population declines") has no encoding as a restricted kind — after the reversal the restriction can only ride on the named individuals, so the subject set itself is never represented
repair_summary: Replaced (Patient sk_decline_1 vermillion), (Patient sk_decline_2 posey) and (Patient sk_decline_3 madison) with the entity-attached surface-preposition atoms (With vermillion sk_decline_1), (With posey sk_decline_2) and (With madison sk_decline_3), modified noun first as in (On sk_ledger_1 sk_workbench_1); proof names renamed from *_pat to *_with so they no longer misdescribe the atom.
notes: Nothing else changed — the three declines keep their class atoms and Future, and the counties keep their Name and county typing. The decline events now carry no thematic role, which is correct: the text names no participant of the declining beyond what population_decline already encodes.
